summary.en: Forward only; sideways too after crossing the river.
summary.zh: 只能前进，过河后也能横走。

text.en: Before crossing the river, a soldier can only move one point forward.
text.zh: 兵在过河前只能向前走一步。

text.en: Once across the river, it may also move one point sideways. It still never moves backward.
text.zh: 过河以后，兵也可以横走一步，但永远不能后退。

text.en: March your soldier across the river to collect the stars.
When can a soldier move backward?
When it reaches the last rank

explanation.en: Soldiers only go forward (and sideways after the river). They never retreat.
explanation.zh: 兵只能前进（过河后可以横走），永不后退。
